personality_one_liner: A precise, serene iOS-native academic companion designed for frictionless daily campus life.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm with safe area padding and comfortable card padding

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom tab bars
Apply translucent tinted base under foreground content
dont's: Never blur form fields or entire screens
Never stack multiple blur cards on top of each other

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Phone OTP verification and role selection for students, teachers, and admins.

states.loading: Authenticating credentials and verifying phone OTP code
states.empty: Enter 10-digit phone number to receive OTP
states.error: Invalid OTP code or network timeout. Please retry.

screens.layout: Centered clean white card with botanical green accent button and clear input field.

screens.name: HomeDashboard
screens.purpose: Central hub displaying role-specific daily schedule, attendance tracker, and quick notices.

states.loading: Loading timetable and active semester records...
states.empty: No active classes or announcements today.
states.error: Failed to sync campus data. Tap retry to reconnect.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable feed with top sticky frosted header, hero schedule card, and quick action grid.

screens.name: Timetable
screens.purpose: Interactive weekly schedule of lectures, labs, and faculty office hours.

states.empty: No classes scheduled for this day.

screens.layout: Horizontal day selector pill bar followed by vertical timeline card stack.

screens.name: Attendance
screens.purpose: Session-based attendance tracking with live check-in and monthly percentage breakdown.
screens.layout: Summary progress gauge at top followed by scrollable course attendance breakdown list.

screens.name: ELibrary
screens.purpose: Digital repository of textbooks, journals, and lecture notes with instant search and download.

states.empty: No library resources found matching your search.

screens.layout: Search bar with category chips followed by 2-column book cover grid.

screens.name: BusTracker
screens.purpose: Real-time campus shuttle routes, stop schedules, and live GPS tracking.

states.empty: No active bus routes at this hour.

screens.layout: Interactive map representation header with route status cards below.

screens.name: CampusChat
screens.purpose: Secure 1-to-1 direct messaging between students, teachers, and administration.

states.empty: No active chats. Start a conversation from your course directory.

screens.layout: Conversation list with unread badges, leading avatar initials, and timestamp metadata.

screens.name: AIAssistant
screens.purpose: Secure backend AI college assistant for academic guidance, syllabus queries, and campus info.

states.empty: Ask me anything about your timetable, library books, or campus policies.

screens.layout: Chat interface with sticky bottom input bar and formatted markdown response cards.

library_hero.alt: Modern campus library interior with reading desks

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement E-Campus mobile app with Flutter + Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Storage, FSM). Use iOS-Native Clean personality with botanical green and warm off-white palette. Ensure strict adherence to WCAG contrast, 44x44 touch targets, safe area compliance, and zero banned colors (indigo/navy). Every screen must have complete loading, empty, and error states.
